violations.text: Sponge, dish soap, and cup were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Raw animal foods (shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (containers of dessert toppings and cream cheese) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses.PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (chlorine ) sanitizing solution for the (3 bay sink ). New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
The condensate from the air conditioner unit is draining into a container. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
